tests.name: Scoped source review
tests.details: Projection and drag agree on +X/right and +Z/down. Drag captures original scene and points-per-meter; moved X/Z clamp to Position.coordinateRange and preserve initial Y. Light taps capture editor generation and verify light existence. Drag writes check generation, selected light, finite input, and current light existence. Completion checks light and generation and clears local ownership before invoking parent. Marker content shape is 44x44; selected marker is above coincident markers, with explicit light-list fallback.
